name: El Monte City Council Notice of Adjournment December 1, 2020
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE
  CITY COUNCIL
  NOTICE OF ADJOURNED REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  AND CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARINGS PURSUANT TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE SECTIONS 54955 AND 54955.1
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the El Monte City Council adjourned its Regular City Council
Meeting and continued its agendized public hearings set for Tuesday, December 1, 2020 to an
Adjourned Regular City Council meeting on Thursday, December 3, 2020 at 6:00 p.m. to take
place at 11333 Valley Boulevard, El Monte, CA 91731.

POSTED AT 7:00 p.m. on December 1, 2020 by Griselda Contreras, Chief Deputy City
Clerk/Records Manager
